detail: B1 run in the field repo. GENERIC teammate: has ToolSearch, tool list [Agent, AskUserQuestion, Bash, Edit, Read, ReportFindings, Skill, ToolSearch, Workflow, Write], ToolSearch('twining') returns "No matching deferred tools found" — so no twining tools exist in the session AT ALL. TWINING agent type: tool list is exactly [Read, Write, Edit, Bash], no ToolSearch — confirms H1 (bare-name allowlist strips everything including ToolSearch). The teammate quoted its SessionStart hook context: "npx is not resolvable even from a login shell, so the twining stdio server could not start and twining tools are absent" — that text matches plugin/hooks/session-start-context.sh:118 verbatim, i.e. launch-server.sh resolved RUNNER=none through all five rungs. CONSEQUENCE: the committed plugin fix (removing the tools: allowlist) is necessary but NOT sufficient in the field — with the server down, even a generic teammate gets nothing. Fixing frontmatter changes nothing until the server starts. Note rung 4 is the plugin-bundled server needing node>=22.13 and NO npx, so runner=none means node itself is unresolvable or below 22.13 in the MCP spawn environment. Diagnostic: bash "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/launch-server.sh" --probe prints runner=X node=Y. No-release workaround: project .mcp.json pointing at an absolute node binary plus the plugin bundle, bypassing PATH entirely. Also check the field .claude/settings.json line the teammate reported (twining-mcp in deniedMcpServers).
summary: B1 confirms BOTH failure modes independently: field blocker is the stdio server never starting (runner=none), which the plugin frontmatter fix does NOT address
